name: Tool_RAG
description: Retrieve related tools from the toolbox based on the provided description

description.description: The description of the tool capability required.

limit.description: The number of tools to retrieve (default: 10)

embedding_model.description: Optional: embedding encoder to use for this search. 'default' = the fine-tuned ToolRAG-T1 (1.5B); 'gte-qwen2-7b' and 'e5-mistral-7b' are larger open encoders with higher accuracy (used only if already in the local model cache unless TOOLUNIVERSE_ALLOW_ENCODER_DOWNLOAD=1; GPU recommended); 'openai-3-large'/'openai-3-small' use hosted OpenAI embeddings (require OpenAI/Azure credentials). Defaults to 'default'.

test_examples.description: Find tools that can perform sequence alignment

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. find_tools has exactly two returns, and which one you get depends on `return_call_result`. Note that the list is NOT a formatted string: prepare_tool_prompts returns a list of trimmed tool configs, which the find_tools docstring still calls "a formatted string".

oneOf.description: return_call_result absent or false: the matching tools' specifications, already cut to `limit` and with the finders themselves and the Finish/CallAgent markers filtered out by configs.exclude_tools. Empty when nothing matched.

items.description: One tool's specification, cut by prepare_tool_prompts(mode='prompt') to the keys an agent needs to call it.

parameter.description: The tool's JSON Schema for its arguments.

oneOf.description: return_call_result=true: a two-element pair of the same specifications and the bare tool names, in that order. It is a Python tuple, which serialises as this array.

items.description: One tool's specification, cut by prepare_tool_prompts(mode='prompt') to the keys an agent needs to call it.

parameter.description: The tool's JSON Schema for its arguments.

name: Tool_Finder_LLM
description: LLM-based tool finder that uses natural language processing to intelligently select relevant tools based on user queries. This tool analyzes all available tool descriptions and uses an LLM to determine which tools would be most helpful for a given task or question.

description.description: The description of the tool capability required.

limit.description: The number of tools to retrieve (default: 10)

picked_tool_names.description: Pre-selected tool names to process. If provided, tool selection will skip these tools.

return_call_result.description: Whether to return both prompts and tool names. If false, returns only tool prompts.

categories.description: Optional list of tool categories to filter by

test_examples.description: Find tools for analyzing gene expression data

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. ToolFinderLLM asks a model to pick the tools, so unlike the embedding finders it has a failure return of its own.

oneOf.description: The model picked tools: their specifications, cut to `limit`. With return_list_only=true this is the list of specifications; empty when the model picked nothing. Empty also when no tool was available to pick from.

items.description: One tool's specification, cut by prepare_tool_prompts(mode='prompt') to the keys an agent needs to call it.

parameter.description: The tool's JSON Schema for its arguments.

oneOf.description: The selection failed: no tools available, none in the requested categories, the model's reply was not valid JSON, or the call raised.

name: Tool_Finder_Jev
description: Tool finder that retrieves a wide BM25 shortlist and grades every candidate with a hosted decision model, for higher accuracy than embedding search without a GPU. Requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Grading sends the search text and the descriptions of the retrieved tools to TypeSafe's hosted service at https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, so do not submit sensitive or patient-identifying information. If grading is unavailable the BM25 retrieval order is returned instead, flagged with graded=false.

description.description: The description of the tool capability required.

limit.description: The number of tools to retrieve (default: 10)

picked_tool_names.description: Pre-selected tool names to process. If provided, retrieval and grading are skipped.

return_call_result.description: Whether to return both prompts and tool names. If false, returns only tool prompts.

categories.description: Optional list of tool categories to filter by

test_examples.description: predict the three-dimensional structure of a protein from its amino-acid sequence
look up which drugs target a given gene in an oncology knowledge base

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.purpose: Grade retrieved tool candidates for relevance so Tool_Finder_Jev can rank them.
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.without: Tool_Finder_Jev is not loaded; the other tool finders are unaffected.

return_schema.description: Ranked tools plus how they were ranked. On failure only 'error' is set.

tool_prompts.description: Tool specifications for the returned names.

candidate_depth.description: How many candidates BM25 retrieved before grading.

graded.description: True when the hosted model graded the shortlist. False means grading was unavailable and the BM25 retrieval order is returned.

grading_error.description: Why grading was unavailable. Present only when graded is false.

note.description: Plain-language statement of the degraded ranking, when graded is false.

provider_notice.description: Disclosure that the search reached TypeSafe's hosted service.

error.description: Why the search could not run at all.
